description: Intent boundary definitions and tie-breaking rules for confusable intent pairs

confusable_pairs.distinguishing_rule: If the customer complains about how quickly the battery discharges or depletes during usage, classify as BATTERY_DRAIN_POWER_CONSUMPTION. If the customer complains about inability to replenish power, charger cable damage, or charging port defects, classify as HARDWARE_CHARGING_POWER_CABLE.

positive_example.text: @AppleSupport Battery draining in recent updates of iOS 11.1 on my iPhone 6s. Why please fix it as soon as possible

counterexample.text: @AppleSupport why is my iphone not charging? i don’t got time for this shit dawg

confusable_pairs.tie_breaker: Customer's focal grievance / actionable need first: if the customer specifically asks how to charge the phone or reports a physical cable/port defect, classify as HARDWARE_CHARGING_POWER_CABLE. If the phone charges normally but drains rapidly during use, classify as BATTERY_DRAIN_POWER_CONSUMPTION. When both symptoms are listed equally without an explicit focal demand, invoke the priority ladder as tie-breaker (HARDWARE_CHARGING_POWER_CABLE > BATTERY_DRAIN_POWER_CONSUMPTION).

confusable_pairs.distinguishing_rule: If the device undergoes binary termination (black screen, reboot loop, crash to home screen, or complete unresponsiveness requiring a hard reset), classify as DEVICE_FREEZE_CRASH_REBOOT. If the device continues operating but exhibits sluggishness, delayed typing, frame drops, or animation lag, classify as PERFORMANCE_SLOWDOWN_LATENCY.

positive_example.text: @115858 @AppleSupport y’all really bout to piss me off with this dumbass update. My phone keeps crashing and shutting off

counterexample.text: My phone is running so slow after I updated it....@115858 wanna explain?

confusable_pairs.tie_breaker: Customer's focal grievance / actionable need first: if the user's primary actionable complaint is total system lockup, kernel crash, or spontaneous restart, classify as DEVICE_FREEZE_CRASH_REBOOT. If the device remains operational with sluggish UI responsiveness, classify as PERFORMANCE_SLOWDOWN_LATENCY. When both are listed without a single dominant grievance, invoke the priority ladder as tie-breaker (DEVICE_FREEZE_CRASH_REBOOT > PERFORMANCE_SLOWDOWN_LATENCY).

confusable_pairs.distinguishing_rule: If only one specific application crashes or fails to open while the rest of iOS functions normally, classify as APP_SPECIFIC_MALFUNCTION. If the entire phone reboots, freezes system-wide, or locks up all apps, classify as DEVICE_FREEZE_CRASH_REBOOT.

positive_example.text: @AppleSupport Safari keeps crashing over and over today. I deleted ~/Library/Safari to start anew, but the problem persists -  sigh

counterexample.text: @115858 @AppleSupport y’all really bout to piss me off with this dumbass update. My phone keeps crashing and shutting off

confusable_pairs.tie_breaker: Customer's focal grievance / actionable need first: if the issue is restricted to a single named application, classify as APP_SPECIFIC_MALFUNCTION. If whole-device instability or reboot loop is reported, classify as DEVICE_FREEZE_CRASH_REBOOT. If an app crash causes a total OS panic/reboot, focal grievance is the device reboot (DEVICE_FREEZE_CRASH_REBOOT).

confusable_pairs.distinguishing_rule: If customer user-generated records (photos, contacts, notes, message history) are missing or deleted and customer seeks recovery, classify as DATA_LOSS_RECOVERY. If customer is unable to authenticate, locked out of their Apple ID, waiting for two-factor recovery, or unable to sign into iCloud services, classify as ACCOUNT_APPLE_ID_ACCESS.

positive_example.text: All my messages are gone. @AppleSupport real cute, sis.

counterexample.text: @AppleSupport how long does it take usually for account recovery to get back to you? It’s been about a week now.

confusable_pairs.tie_breaker: Customer's focal grievance / actionable need first: if the customer's primary blocker is an account lockout preventing access, classify as ACCOUNT_APPLE_ID_ACCESS; if account access is intact but synced user data has disappeared, classify as DATA_LOSS_RECOVERY. When an account lockout and data loss are equally presented without explicit focus, invoke the priority ladder (ACCOUNT_APPLE_ID_ACCESS > DATA_LOSS_RECOVERY).

confusable_pairs.distinguishing_rule: Physical display panel anomalies (flicker, dead pixels, lines, touch digitizer unresponsive) and biometric sensor defects (Touch ID, Face ID) belong to SCREEN_DISPLAY_TOUCH_BIOMETRICS. System-wide freeze with black screen, forced reboot, or boot loop belongs to DEVICE_FREEZE_CRASH_REBOOT.

positive_example.text: My 6 month old IPhone 6 touch screen is unresponsive. @AppleSupport please help!

counterexample.text: @115858 @AppleSupport y’all really bout to piss me off with this dumbass update. My phone keeps crashing and shutting off

confusable_pairs.tie_breaker: When display/biometric defect occurs simultaneously with an OS crash, customer focal grievance takes precedence; if tied, DEVICE_FREEZE_CRASH_REBOOT (priority rank 3) breaks tie over SCREEN_DISPLAY_TOUCH_BIOMETRICS (priority rank 7).

confusable_pairs.distinguishing_rule: If issue involves inability to log into Apple ID, 2FA codes, forgotten passwords, or account disabling, classify as ACCOUNT_APPLE_ID_ACCESS. If issue involves money, credit card charges, iTunes invoices, or subscriptions, classify as BILLING_CHARGE_REFUND_DISPUTE.

positive_example.text: locked out of my apple ID bcuz my old phone broke & i had 2 factor authentication on , no one should ever use tht shit @115858

counterexample.text: You charged me for Apple Music but didn’t even tell me my trial was over. I want a refund @AppleSupport

confusable_pairs.tie_breaker: Customer's focal grievance / actionable need first: if customer's explicit request is for a refund or subscription cancellation, classify as BILLING_CHARGE_REFUND_DISPUTE; if customer's primary blocker is logging into their Apple ID, classify as ACCOUNT_APPLE_ID_ACCESS. When an account lockout is triggered by a disputed charge and customer asks to resolve the charge, focal need is BILLING_CHARGE_REFUND_DISPUTE.

confusable_pairs.distinguishing_rule: If performance lag, crashing, or errors are isolated to a single named application (e.g. Safari, Mail, Twitter, Spotify), classify as APP_SPECIFIC_MALFUNCTION. If the entire device UI, typing, navigation, and overall system response is slow or sluggish across all apps, classify as PERFORMANCE_SLOWDOWN_LATENCY.

positive_example.text: @AppleSupport Safari keeps crashing over and over today. I deleted ~/Library/Safari to start anew, but the problem persists -  sigh

counterexample.text: My phone is running so slow after I updated it....@115858 wanna explain?

confusable_pairs.tie_breaker: Customer's focal grievance / actionable need first: if sluggishness is reported generally across the OS, classify as PERFORMANCE_SLOWDOWN_LATENCY; if customer focuses on a single app failing to respond, classify as APP_SPECIFIC_MALFUNCTION. When tied without focal demand, invoke priority ladder (APP_SPECIFIC_MALFUNCTION > PERFORMANCE_SLOWDOWN_LATENCY).
